column2: Are cryptographic keys managed through a documented key management lifecycle?
column4: Keys are generated and stored in AWS KMS with automatic annual rotation. Access is restricted to the platform security team and every use is logged to CloudTrail.

column2: Is customer data encrypted at rest using industry standard algorithms?
column4: All customer data at rest is encrypted with AES-256. Database volumes and object storage buckets use envelope encryption managed by AWS KMS.

column2: Do you perform penetration testing of your production environment?
column4: An independent third party performs a full penetration test annually. Critical and high findings are remediated within 30 days and a summary letter is available under NDA.

column2: Are background checks performed on all personnel prior to employment?
column4: Background screening is completed for all employees and contractors before their start date, where permitted by local law.

column2: What is your documented recovery time objective for critical systems?
column4: The recovery time objective for tier 1 services is 4 hours and the recovery point objective is 15 minutes. Restore procedures are exercised twice per year.
